result.reason: The redline narrows the restriction and includes the required internal-development and acquisition carve-outs, but it does not cap the restriction at 12 months; it could continue for any longer agreement term. It also applies broadly to “Deerskin Products” rather than clearly identifying a single named competing product. The automatic termination for any failure under Section 1 is an additional, potentially ambiguous change not required by the playbook. The clause otherwise preserves the arrangement’s core intent and is generally readable, though subsection (b) is redundant with the opening term limitation.
